questions.question: Give two ways in which a rectangle and a parallelogram are the same, and one way they are different.
questions.expected_answer: Both have two pairs of parallel sides, and both have opposite sides equal. A rectangle has four right angles, but a parallelogram does not need to have any right angles.

questions.question: Why is a rectangle a special kind of parallelogram?
questions.expected_answer: A parallelogram is any quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides. A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram, and it is special because all four of its angles are right angles.

questions.question: What happens to the sides and angles when Mr Dlamini pushes a rectangular frame sideways?
questions.expected_answer: The sides keep their lengths and stay parallel, so the frame is still a parallelogram. The angles change: two become acute and two become obtuse, so it is no longer a rectangle.
